rules:
- A1.2 teacher style.
- Prefer present tense.
- Use one clear clause, with an occasional simple fixed phrase.
- Keep sentence length around 6 to 9 words.
- Use practical contexts such as home, shopping, transport, family, school, and work.
- Use simple adjectives naturally, not decoratively.
- Nominative and accusative should appear naturally when useful.
- Dative may appear only in very common fixed patterns such as mit + dative.
- Questions should still be very practical and everyday.
- Avoid genitive and complex connectors.
